AnalysisRequest.description: Submitted sessions are accepted only in fixture mode; live analysis reads persisted rows.
AnalysisRequest.title: AnalysisRequest

BaseVersion.description: Frozen v1 identity and its fixed checks. A patch run never changes it.
BaseVersion.title: BaseVersion

BoundedEdit.description: Replace one exact, unique text span in one product file.
BoundedEdit.title: BoundedEdit

ContinuationResult.description: Optional continuation attempts. They never enter the mandatory denominators.
ContinuationResult.title: ContinuationResult

IsolatedPatch.description:
A changeset held in the run record. It is not written to the v1 tree.

The digest covers the files only. Edits record how the files were derived from v1.
IsolatedPatch.title: IsolatedPatch

ModelTime.description: Elapsed agent time. It is never an estimate of how long a human would take.

basis.default: agent wall clock between first and last recorded action; not human time
basis.title: Basis

ModelTime.title: ModelTime

OutcomeCounts.description: Every expected identity lands in exactly one bucket; the buckets sum to the target.
OutcomeCounts.title: OutcomeCounts

ProposalDraft.description: A UX reviewer draft. Only supported drafts may enter later lifecycle review.
ProposalDraft.title: ProposalDraft

ReleaseCreate.description: A human composes two or three regression-passed runs into one v2 candidate run.
ReleaseCreate.title: ReleaseCreate

RetestRequest.description: C's handoff to B: run each frozen v1 identity once on the approved v2.
RetestRequest.title: RetestRequest

RoleRun.description: Provenance returned by the shared HF adapter for one structured role call.
RoleRun.title: RoleRun

SoftwareReviewEvidence.description: A review report, not a measured user action or a demographic observation.
SoftwareReviewEvidence.title: SoftwareReviewEvidence

TrialAttempt.description:
One executed (or attempted) session with the identity it ran under.

Mandatory attempts form the 500-person comparison. A continuation attempt is optional
and follows a mandatory attempt whose feedback chose to continue.
TrialAttempt.title: TrialAttempt

TrialIdentity.description: Everything that must stay fixed between a persona's v1 and v2 attempts.
TrialIdentity.title: TrialIdentity

info.description: Fixture-first scaffold; real integration and experiment gates remain required.
info.title: RepoFusion API

post.description: The implementer applies each component's edits, in order, to frozen v1.
The HF implementer proposes bounded edits; the deterministic tool applies them.
Run the fixed checks in an isolated workspace and record their results.
